title: SIMON published message answer
description: GET /simon/messages/<id>: the message, its author's edits and retraction of it that the reader may see (changes: the latest 100 edits, oldest first, then the retraction), and its carrier's signed claims when it made any. No keys are served beside it: a reader verifies against the author's agent document, resolved independently; pruning or private retirement may prevent fresh verification of older messages.

changes.description: The author's own edits of this message, the latest 100, oldest first, then its retraction when it has one (publishing profile, section 1).
